purpose: Read-only operator browser for the append-only audit ledger, filtered entries, payload evidence, exports and on-demand SHA-256 row-hash verification.
primaryGoal: Find an audit event, inspect its actor/entity/outcome and before/after evidence, and understand exactly which bounded rows were verified without overstating ledger integrity.

dataSources.contract: Envelope unwrapped by fetchEnvelope; snake_case query keys since/until/categories/actors/actions/entity_type/limit/offset. Repo filters ts >= since and ts < until, sorts ts DESC/id DESC, returns rows and limit, not total.
dataSources.policy: Params participate in the query key; AbortSignal forwarded; MODERATE stale time, STANDARD polling, no background interval, retry 1.
dataSources.scope: Instance-wide admin ledger; seven local controls; server paging. No selected vehicle. Counts are current loaded page only.

dataSources.contract: Independent distinct non-null category catalog, sorted and capped at 100; not a full-ledger cardinality or filtered-page count.
dataSources.policy: EXTENDED stale time, RARE polling, no background interval, retry 1, AbortSignal forwarded.

dataSources.contract: Independent action catalog capped at 100, ordered by most recent occurrence; not a full-ledger cardinality.
dataSources.policy: EXTENDED stale time, RARE polling, no background interval, retry 1, AbortSignal forwarded.

dataSources.contract: Explicit refetch only; backend defaults since to now minus 30 days. Checks up to 1000 rows with non-null row_hash in ascending ts/id order. Returns intact, first_bad_id, rows_checked, since, limit. Not tied to entry filters; not every ledger row or a proven chain-link continuity check.
dataSources.policy: Initially disabled, no interval, FAST stale time, retry 1, AbortSignal forwarded.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Custom Details/Hide column duplicates DataTable's built-in expansion control. The custom control has no aria-expanded; the built-in leading control does.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Use the existing DataTable expansion owner. Preserve a discoverable localized Details affordance and controlled expansion; remove redundancy only after desktop/mobile keyboard parity is demonstrated.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Per-metric source context repeats alongside PageContainer's source notice. This is useful source attribution, not proof of a cross-page duplicate component need.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Retain metric scope and independent recovery; consider consolidating repeated text locally without removing failed-source retry or retained-data context. Do not invent a new source-status registry.

sourceStrategy: Controls/integrity stack until xl, then use 2:1 width (AuditLogPage.tsx:61).
Filter inputs use one column, sm two and 3xl three; actions wrap (AuditLogFilters.tsx:15,79).
Compact brief uses one/sm two/md three/1920 six metrics (OperationalBrief.tsx:169-173).
Table retains action/success/ts under md; built-in expansion remains separate (AuditLogEntries.tsx:65; DataTable.tsx:724-725,1128).
Expanded metadata wraps; payloads stack then md two columns with max-height and wrapping (AuditExpandedDetail.tsx:16,35-37).

issues.detail: Actor/category/entity/detail/trace columns are hidden below md. Expansion exposes IP/user-agent/trace/hash/payloads, but not full actor/category/entity/detail. The page does not opt into the existing mobilePresentation adapter.
issues.fix: Reuse DataTable.mobilePresentation with stable row identity and full details covering every hidden field plus current expanded evidence; preserve ordering, paging, export and expansion state. Confirm column-menu behavior on the actual mounted page before asserting present accessibility.

accessibility.verification: keyboard, screen reader, focus, touch geometry and contrast unverified
sourceStrengths: Localized Input/Select labels; decorative filter/status icons hidden; outcomes have explicit OK/Fail/Chain intact/Chain broken text.
Built-in DataTable expansion has aria-expanded and localized accessible names.
LayoutCard labelled by generated title ID; PageContainer retains route-focus heading; FadeIn consumes reduced-motion preference.

issues.detail: Previous/Next use size=sm without the min-h-11 already present on filter actions. Button.sm specifies h-9. Verify-chain and custom Details also use sm. This is a source-level 36px sizing risk, not measured WCAG failure.
issues.fix: Use existing Button sizing/className to provide mobile min-h-11 and wrapping labels while preserving disabled states. Assess spacing exceptions and actual target geometry before acceptance.

issues.detail: Trace and row-hash icon-only CopyButton calls omit contextual ariaLabel, so both default to generic Copy. Table trace copy also has the generic label.
issues.fix: Supply existing ariaLabel prop with localized Copy trace ID / Copy row hash plus safe row context; retain full copied text and copied-state feedback. No new clipboard primitive needed.

inventory.initialLoading: Missing entry payload -> 320px skeleton; catalogs produce missing metrics and loading context. Verification skeleton only after explicit request.
inventory.empty: Successful zero rows -> explanatory EmptyState inviting wider/cleared filters; zero loaded page counts remain legitimate measured counts.
inventory.fatalError: Entry QueryError retries locally; catalog QueryError recovery in metric context; verifier QueryError retries independently.
inventory.retainedRefreshError: deriveDataState keeps usable payload; table reads retained rows; brief labels retained counts; PageLayout source notice displays stale/partial independently.
inventory.offline: Shared DataSourceNotice uses query fetchStatus and online status. No browser offline exercise performed.
inventory.unsupported: Entry fatal 503 currently triggers unsupported notice and suppresses tableError.
inventory.verificationIdle: Explicit read-only verification prompt; disabled query excluded from source notices until fetch/data/fatal error.
inventory.verificationSuccess: Badge plus rows_checked and first_bad_id when broken; previous success remains during refetch.
inventory.disabled: Previous disabled at offset zero; Next disabled when loaded rows < requested limit; Verify disabled while fetching.

issues.rule: MDC-025 / MDC-026 / unsupported is not outage
issues.detail: Any initial HTTP 503 is interpreted as subsystem not configured; code SUBSYSTEM_NOT_CONFIGURED is not checked. A generic service outage would receive unsupported copy and lose the table retry.
issues.fix: Classify unsupported only from the explicit backend error code. Route other 503 errors through existing QueryError/data-unavailability recovery; keep all unaffected sources visible.

issues.detail: Chain intact and the idle promise to re-derive every row_hash overstate a bounded verification. Current call omits since and caps at 1000; backend uses last 30 days, excludes null hashes and checks per-row recomputation. Returned since/limit are not shown. Zero checked rows also gets Chain intact.
issues.fix: Describe bounded row-hash verification, show response since/limit/rows_checked, distinguish zero checked from positive verified evidence, and annotate retained result while refreshing/failed/offline. Preserve explicit refetch, first_bad_id and all integrity outcomes without inventing backend continuity guarantees.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 / MDC-012 / MDC-040 / restrained themed controls
visualIssues.detail: The page's built-in table expansion control inherits fixed white hover overlay and cyan-500 focus ring instead of current control-hover/focus tokens. No neon/glow/pure-white feature classes were found in the nine scoped feature files.
visualIssues.fix: Shared owner should replace hover:bg-white/[0.06] with existing --control-bg-hover and focus:ring-cyan-500 with --focus-ring, retaining visible outlines and touch-target-overlay. Keep neutral metadata and semantic success/danger badges; do not add glow or replace saved themes.

architectureIssues.detail: Dated list uses page-local Since/Until controls and local state; /admin/audit-log is absent from RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS. These are ledger scope, not independent business dates. Filter state is not URL-backed despite the page header comment claiming query URL reproduction.
architectureIssues.fix: Integrate existing header View settings/useRangeState and typed since/until parameters with both server bounds, no second date picker. Preserve initial unbounded ledger access and minute-level custom scopes during transition rather than silently imposing the hook's 7-day default. Preserve reset/search/non-date filters and explicitly decide URL persistence for them. Keep admin vehicle scope disabled.

architectureIssues.detail: exportRow supplies wire keys entity_type/entity_id/trace_id, while visible columns use entity/trace. DataTable projects exportRow through visible column keys, dropping ID/IP/user_agent/hash fields and exporting entity/trace as null. before/after are not supplied. Loaded-page scope must not be advertised as full-ledger export.
architectureIssues.fix: Use existing DataTable.onExport(format, rows, scope) for original scoped records or explicitly align exportValue keys and document visible-column scope. Preserve all currently intended export metadata, include payload evidence when full-record export is intended, retain table ID/file naming and truthful loaded/selected scope. No fabricated exportAll endpoint.

architectureIssues.detail: Frontend increments zero-based offset by limit, serializer forwards offset unchanged, but handler subtracts one from each positive offset. Service passes it directly to SQL OFFSET. A request offset=100 therefore starts at offset=99, overlapping pages and disagreeing with Showing 101... text.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner should align the API zero-based offset contract and add focused boundary tests for offset 0/100/200; do not compensate with a presentation-only hidden offset or change this backend in the page audit.

architectureIssues.detail: Before/After are Go []byte with JSON tags, so standard JSON serialization produces base64 strings, while AuditExpandedDetail JSON.parse expects JSON text and otherwise displays the string. fetchEnvelope only unwraps; no payload conversion is shown in that hook. Actual HTTP serialization/client behavior was not exercised.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner must inspect/verify actual wire responses and choose one documented payload representation before changing rendering or types; preserve exact raw before/after evidence. Do not silently discard unparseable/base64 values or claim a JSON-tree feature.
